statusDefinitions.satisfied: Existing evidence is executable or reviewable and may be cited now.
statusDefinitions.partial: Useful evidence exists, but the slice-specific contract is incomplete.
statusDefinitions.missing: The evidence must be created in the stated phase.
statusDefinitions.blocked: External, human, governed-data, or live-environment input is required.
statusDefinitions.conditional: Required only if the approved design chooses the applicable replacement or migration path.
statusDefinitions.not_applicable: The evidence category does not apply to this slice.

globalItems.note: A generated hash-backed audit and locked-dependency inventory exist, but the live mixed main worktree has drifted from them. Regenerate and review both in the clean exact-start-commit worktree immediately before starting a slice; do not refresh them now merely to absorb unrelated in-flight product changes.
Align @types/node with Node 22, disposition stale worktrees with unique commits, and start implementation in a recorded dedicated codex/refactor-* worktree.

A reviewed per-function baseline exists, but the current mixed main worktree exceeds it. Begin a slice only from a clean reviewed commit where the ratchet passes, or where every pre-existing failure has a named owner and an approved non-regression disposition.

A repository-owner CODEOWNERS route exists, but there is no independent backup/reviewer and main currently requires zero approvals, does not require code-owner review, and permits administrator bypass. Name the independent reviewer path and enforce the reviewed branch-protection checks before a slice starts.

The guarded cloud controller dispatches focused and independent checks, but main protection currently requires only the verify job and ordinary pull requests do not run the browser, operational, or PostgreSQL jobs. Define and enforce the commit-attached required-check set for refactor pull requests before implementation.

The baseline generator now records separate complexity, churn, fan-in, dependency, branch-depth, duplication, control-plane, and planned-slice signals without collapsing them into a correctness score. Generate and review the risk inventory from the clean exact starting commit; the current mixed worktree is not start evidence.
The process explicitly permits only bounded candidate-commit claims and prohibits whole-application bug-free, perfect, or unqualified formal-verification claims.

The evaluation harness and public calibration suite are agent-drafted bootstrap candidates. Before any slice starts, humans must validate the scenarios and anti-patterns, run matched first-attempt baseline/candidate trials with blind review and private holdouts, keep an exact-commit guidance bundle, and record the adopted comparison. Passing the structural checker alone is not adoption evidence.

items.note: Existing rules are strong; freeze representative return values, audit events, database effects, and errors before moving code. Owner purpose statement recorded verbatim on 2026-09-06: "accomplish gathering the full profile for eventual admission, and with the assessment, make that decision, generally only one person will touch the referral from start to finish, there are a few that will be assigned referral but will only do the assessment and hopefully wotn need to change the workspace creation part". Owner role direction recorded 2026-09-06: most referral owners carry the workspace from creation through the decision process; two assessors generally receive assignments and also create their own workspaces; one assessment-only assessor receives assigned work and ordinarily changes only assessment information; verified profile corrections by that assessor are permitted and attributable. Workspace ownership direction recorded 2026-09-06: the staff member who receives the referral and creates its workspace owns it; when a supervisor assigns the workspace, the assigning supervisor and the assignee share ownership. This desired joint-ownership behavior differs from the current single owner/ownerId representation and must be implemented, reviewed, certified, and included in the exact-start baseline as a separate product behavior change before the structural slice. Change-history direction recorded 2026-09-06: every material workspace change must be durably attributed and presented in an obvious changelog module when the workspace is opened. Reuse the existing referral Activity/audit path rather than create a parallel history owner; exact sensitive-value presentation still requires owner confirmation. Owner direction recorded 2026-09-06: suspected matches by normalized name and county should trigger human review with open-existing or confirm-different-person outcomes, never automatic identity linking or merging. The owner also provisionally selected field-aware optimistic saving as the target: non-overlapping field edits preserve both users' changes, same-field edits require an explicit conflict decision, sparse saves never replace untouched values, and important identity or clinical changes retain governed provenance, actor, time, prior value, and reason. These are separate product behavior changes and are not part of the structural slice until separately implemented, reviewed, certified, and included in the exact-start baseline.

Run the same referral contract scenarios against both adapters without erasing PostgreSQL-only transaction semantics. Owner direction recorded 2026-09-06: local mode must expose enough actor and audit information for shared behavioral tests, while PostgreSQL remains the sole production owner of transactionally durable audit_events. The exact local observable and shared assertions remain to be designed and executed.

Freeze exact replay outcomes per command. Owner direction recorded 2026-09-06: a repeated create with the same mutation identifier returns the original referral without applying a second mutation; patch, trash, and restore use optimistic conflict recovery rather than replay idempotency; trash remains restorable for 30 days. Exact response, audit, database-effect, and concurrency evidence is still missing.
Static route coverage exists; add executed allow, wrong-role, and wrong-resource cases for each mutation in scope.
The platform baseline exists; rerun the store profile against the approved slice and review query-plan deltas.
Static compatibility policy exists; N/N-1 behavior still needs a disposable PostgreSQL rehearsal.
Add store-specific mutants for audit attribution, section versions, idempotency, and transaction coupling.

The referral responsibilities, comprehension questions, stale-write, retry, and audit-atomicity obligations are agent-drafted setup candidates. The 2026-09-06 owner explain-back did not yet demonstrate the concurrency, atomic-side-effect, or adapter-audit model, so human validation and the independent pre-change comprehension review remain required before implementation.
Bind verified obligations, required gates, post-change comprehension, two clean adversarial passes, rollback evidence, and human-accepted medium/low residual risks to one referral candidate commit.

Freeze draft, schedule, start, sign, addendum, provenance, audit, and failure behavior, including assessment-owned synchronization back into referral workflow state and its local/PostgreSQL transaction differences. Owner role direction recorded 2026-09-06: one supervisor performs assessments; two assessors generally both own referrals and perform assessments; one assessment-only assessor works assigned assessments and does not ordinarily alter workspace-creation information, except for verified attributable corrections.
Implement the shared assessment scenario suite before moving adapter boundaries.
Static route coverage exists; add executed assessor, supervisor, wrong-resource, and worker denial cases.
The platform baseline exists; rerun the store profile against the approved slice and review query-plan deltas.
Prove new code reads historical drafts, signatures, field evidence, and addenda without rewriting them.
Add mutants for signer attribution, immutable signatures, provenance loss, and reassignment credit.

The assessment lifecycle, signed immutability, provenance, authorization, and workflow-synchronization obligations are setup candidates. The human owner must validate them and complete the pre-change comprehension review.
Bind verified obligations, historical compatibility, required gates, post-change comprehension, adversarial review, recovery, and accepted residual risks to one assessment candidate commit.

Rules are characterized; add golden database effects and emitted audit events for representative transitions. Owner decision recorded 2026-09-06: the head supervisor may deny a clearly unsuitable referral before assessment completion, but the decision requires an attributable reason and durable history; approval otherwise depends on the completed assessment and gathered profile.

Complete executable allow and deny coverage for recommendation, terminal decision, assignment, and EHR handoff mutations. Owner role direction recorded 2026-09-06: final approval or denial belongs to the head supervisor who performs no assessments and makes the decision after discussion with the CEO or other leadership; assessment participation alone does not grant terminal-decision authority.

Define and execute the replay contract for recommendation, terminal decision, work-item, and EHR handoff commands. These routes currently use optimistic versions without client mutation identifiers, so the owner must distinguish at-most-once conflict safety from same-result idempotency before preserving or changing retry behavior.
The current certified workflow mutants are killed; retain this gate and expand only when the approved slice exposes new failure modes.
